ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the white structure shown in the diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a diagram of an open oral cavity structure, with rows of obvious white hard structures arranged on the upper and lower sides of the oral cavity, located at the edge of the gums, shaped like single adjacent block-like structures arranged next to each other. Reasoning: The question asks what the white structures in the figure are; in the human oral cavity, these white hard structures arranged in the upper and lower jaws and used for chewing are teeth. Therefore the answer is teeth.
